user_query: trass gmail with term mgm from last 2 months

intent.goal: find gmail content containing 'mgm' in trass workspace

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
  u.page_id,
  u.title,
  u.created_time,
  g.sender_email,
  u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE (u.database_name LIKE 'trass.gmail' OR u.database_name = 'gmail')
AND (u.title LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.subject LIKE '%mgm%')
AND u.created_time >= date('now', '-2 months')
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1000
